Class ScriptTemplateView

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.reactive.result.view.AbstractView
org.springframework.web.reactive.result.view.AbstractUrlBasedView
org.springframework.web.reactive.result.view.script.ScriptTemplateView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanNameAware, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, View
public class ScriptTemplateView extends AbstractUrlBasedView
An AbstractUrlBasedView subclass designed to run any template library based on a JSR-223 script engine.

如果未设置，每个属性将通过在 Web 应用程序上下文中查找单个ScriptTemplateConfig Bean 并从中获取配置的属性来进行自动检测。

Nashorn JavaScript 引擎需要 Java 8+，并且可能需要将sharedEngine属性设置为false才能正常运行。有关详细信息，请参阅ScriptTemplateConfigurer.setSharedEngine(Boolean)。

Since:
5.0
Author:
Sebastien Deleuze, Juergen Hoeller

      public void setApplicationContext(@Nullable ApplicationContext context)
      描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware
      Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in. Normally this call will be used to initialize the object.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。
